item.description:
### Added - GPU section: a new GPU card (live utilization, sparkline, chip name) on Apple Silicon, plus a GPU row in the status menu - Updates are now visible everywhere: a thin green strip along the top of the window, an “Update to vX…” row in the status menu, and a row in Settings — declining is re-offered on the next launch
### Changed - Status-bar menu redesigned in the style of the Stats app: each stat is a row with a colored utilization bar, and Open Pulse, Settings, and Quit (which also stops the background sampler) are the only actions - Row order and visibility are configurable in Settings, with a separate switch for which rows appear in the dropdown and which show as button capsules — hiding all of them is a valid layout - The button's NET capsule shows pinned ↓/↑ arrows with right-aligned figures, using the same B → KB → MB → GB units as the dashboard
### Fixed - Status-bar menu: clicking the icon again now closes the menu — like every other menu-bar app — and clicking a stat row just closes it - The button no longer blinks when a stat is toggled in Settings, and settings saved in the dashboard are no longer silently reverted by the app - After a rebuild, the background sampler restarts onto the new code instead of leaving a second parallel one behind - The thermal chip on the CPU card only appears when the machine is actually being throttled
